$comment: Workflow overhaul no-legacy guard (README §7 step 6, R-1). `banned`: identifiers each phase removed, APPENDED in the same commit that deletes them; a regex `pattern` matched per line against packages/** and apps/** source (tests, dist, node_modules excluded), optional `paths` prefixes; any hit fails. `comments`: `@deprecated` / `legacy` / `backward compat` / `fallback for old` inside comments of the workflow-module files matched by `paths` (regex sources). Report-only while `phase` < `failFromPhase` (null = not scheduled), but the count may never exceed `baseline`. Each phase bumps `phase` and lowers `baseline`; the phase that clears the module sets `failFromPhase` to itself.
